text_block_list.text:
While training for her next race, the 
Osaka Hai, Maruzensky is approached by 
Symboli Rudolf.

She praised Maruzensky for continually 
setting the ideal example for her juniors, 
and expressed a genuine desire to face her 
in a match.

Having been challenged to a duel by 
Symboli Rudolf, the one hailed as the 
"Emperor," Maruzensky imagines the race 
with eager anticipation.

A few days later, Symboli Rudolf announced 
her entry into the Osaka Hai to face off 
against Maruzensky.
